Source: Bob Starbird / Windows User, Unfiltered Searches.docx
Key points used: Two-phase search; unfiltered vs filtered; false positives from punctuation, whitespace, case, wildcards, diacritics, positions, stemming; NOT false-negative rule; index options.
Filtered is default; filtered eliminates false-positive matches; unfiltered selects candidate fragments and can include false positives, missed matches, or incorrect matches.
op.fromSearch fragments are not filtered and are selected in the same manner as unfiltered cts:search operations.
op.fromSearchDocs takes a CTS query and is a convenience around op.fromSearch plus doc/URI join.
Optic supports CTS queries as filters; Optic searches are unfiltered.
